title: examples/minimal-game addon copy: waiter.gd missing await on wait_condition() calls
body: examples/minimal-game/addons/stagehand/core/waiter.gd lines 106 and 144 call wait_condition() without await. The main addon (addons/stagehand/core/waiter.gd) uses `var success: bool = await wait_condition(...)` but the example copy uses `var success = wait_condition(...)` (no await). Godot 4 rejects this at compile time with 'Function wait_condition() is a coroutine, so it must be called with await', blocking the autoload from loading. The example copy needs to be resynced from the main addon — specifically waiter.gd needs await added on lines 106 and 144.

title: examples/minimal-game/Main.tscn is Godot 3.x format, fails to parse under Godot 4
body: examples/minimal-game/Main.tscn uses Godot 3.x resource format ('ext_resource' section type) which Godot 4 cannot parse. ERROR: res://Main.tscn:1 - Parse Error: Unrecognized file type 'ext_resource'. The example cannot run until Main.tscn is ported to Godot 4 format. Also project.godot used `config/main_scene` (Godot 3.x) instead of `run/main_scene` (Godot 4) — that was fixed in godot-stagehand-dq3.
